programme.desc: Witchcraft In The Devil's Triangle. The Witchcraft is one of the strangest disappearances from the Bermuda Triangle. An expedition leads to a shocking discovery on the sea floor. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Hunt For The Chupacabra. Josh Gates embarks on yet another mission, this time into the dark caves and thick jungles of Puerto Rico in search of the mysterious Chupacabra. S6, Ep5

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Cracking The Secret. Josh Gates travels across America in the hopes of cracking the location of some ceramic vases, buried by an author in 1982 that can be exchanged for treasure. S6, Ep6

programme.title: Alaska: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: Storm Shelter Showdown - Part 2. The Raneys arrive in Missouri to see a family that has just survived a tornado. Living in a crumbling cabin, they also have no clean water source. S1, Ep19

programme.title: Alaska: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: High And Dry. Amputee Jeff and wife Carol need a liveable home, water, and a place to grow food. The Raneys build an entire cabin from scratch and harness a natural spring. S2, Ep1

programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters
programme.desc: Start With A Bang. The Bushmen bring in an explosives expert to blast through the toughest rock in Grawin. A brand-new team brings cutting edge technology to the opal fields. S6, Ep1

programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters
programme.desc: Baptism By Fire. The Cheals take on their most dangerous dig ever. The Bushmen trial a rookie to operate their exploration drill, but it doesn't go as smoothly as they'd hoped. S6, Ep2

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: Machinery breakdowns cause tensions to rise in the Poseidon Crew. The Ferals are moved onto a new lease, and the Gold Timers get stranded. S6, Ep3

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: An old treasure map leads the Poseidon Crew to a big nugget. Marcus and Linden call in some expert help, while Shane and Russell take a financial gamble. S6, Ep4

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: A Horse Of A Different Color. Jeff and his team head to a remote town where they encounter an unexpected animal. In Denver, Dr Amy treats a kitten with a mysterious injury. S4, Ep21

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Close To Home. Dr Jeff helps a remote town which has become overwhelmed with feral cats. Plus, a staff member's dog needs emergency surgery and Jeff rushes to save a Chihuahua. S4, Ep22

programme.title: Expedition X
programme.desc: Death Island. Josh Gates sends the team to reportedly the most haunted place in America: Mackinac Island. This remote island has experienced over 1,000 years of bloodshed. S4, Ep1

programme.title: Naked and Afraid XL
programme.desc: All-Stars: Fight To The Finish. To finish the challenge, the survivalists must complete a brutal extraction across deadly killing fields of lions, crocodiles and leopards. S3, Ep9

programme.title: Gold Divers
programme.desc: Every Ounce Counts. Shawn works overtime to cover for his exhausted crew. Kris is blindsided by the loss of his lead diver. Meanwhile, Emily jumps in to prevent a fuel spill. S7, Ep7

programme.title: Gold Divers
programme.desc: Closing The Gap. Winter winds force the captains to reassess risk and reward. Shawn's mega-barge extraction worsens, and Ken pushes the Myrtle to the limit on a five-day run. S7, Ep8

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: The Dust Devils' operation halts and the hold-up could cost them thousands of dollars. A cyclone causes damage to Shane and Russell's wash plant. S5, Ep16

programme.title: Building Off The Grid

programme.title: Deadliest Catch

programme.title: Curse of the Bermuda Triangle
programme.desc: Ghost Ship Terror. Sightings of ghost ships in the Bermuda Triangle have been reported for centuries. Experts and scientists use cutting-edge technology to try and solve the mystery. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Alaska: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: Poisoned. Soil poisoned by coal production hampers a Kentucky homestead. The Raneys must build a hillside garden on the only unpolluted land and find a source of clean water. S2, Ep2

programme.title: Alaska: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: Flood, Sweat, & Tears - Part 1. A dangerous request from the Smith family in a Missouri flood zone forces the Raneys to build a dam and plan an entire cabin move. S2, Ep3

programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters
programme.desc: In Search Of Fuel. The Opal Whisperers work underground together for the first time on a legendary claim. The Mooka Boys are forced to work Leif's late father's abandoned mine. S6, Ep3

programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters
programme.desc: A Well That Takes On Water. The Digi Diggers need to explore new ground after mining opal too brittle to sell. The Bushmen find their new claim has been dug out by opal thieves. S6, Ep4

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: After a frustrating day, the Ferals hit a gold hot streak. An injury rocks the Gold Timers, while Shane and Russell struggle with their homemade sluice. S6, Ep5

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: Prospectors Jacqui and Andrew uncover gold in Queensland. The Poseidon Crew get some exciting news, while the Dust Devils spend big on new equipment. S6, Ep6

programme.title: Gold Divers
programme.desc: The Wolf Of Wall Streak. Chris McCully and crew hit a paystreak so lucrative they call it 'Wall Street.' Shawn strikes gold at 40 feet under the ice. Vernon's diver faces a disaster. S11, Ep27

programme.title: Gold Divers
programme.desc: Jane's Affliction. Jane clashes with Emily's crew over being disrespected. Equipment failures cause delays for Chris and Shawn. Kris is thrilled to find his Crawler in action. S11, Ep28

programme.title: Expedition X
